name: fi.soheil/router
title: Soheil Router
description: Best-price swaps and bridges on 100+ networks, by wallet or deposit, with token safety checks.

tools.name: get_networks
tools.description: Where Soheil Router trades. "networks": the EVM networks with our contract (chain id, name, contract, fee, the contracts a trade may call). "otherNetworks": Solana, Bitcoin, TON, Tron, Sui, Hyperliquid, Cosmos networks and the networks paid by deposit, each with its chainId, how its addresses look (type), its coin (nativeToken), the tokens it takes (tokens; null = any), and whether trades can be paid out there (receive), start there (send) or swap there (swap). No API key needed.

tools.name: find_token
tools.description: A token's address, decimals and price in USD. By symbol ("USDC"): the well-known tokens of our lists, on the network given or on every network that has one. By contract address with chainId: any token, read from the chain when our lists do not have it and then marked verified: false. Anyone can make a token with any symbol, so trade by address and run check_token on an unverified one. No API key needed.

chainId.description: The network, a chainId from get_networks; required with an address, optional with a symbol

query.description: The token's symbol (USDC, WETH) or its contract address

tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Soheil Guard's safety check of a token before buying it: can it be sold back (a quote, and on EVM networks a test buy, transfer and sale that sends nothing), hidden fees, who controls the contract and what they can do (mint, pause, block wallets, change fees), freeze and mint authorities on Solana, how much the largest wallets hold, the token's age and who owns its liquidity. Returns verdict (KNOWN, OK, CAUTION, RISKY or NOT_CHECKED) and the findings, worst first, each with a level and a sentence. On EVM networks, Solana, Tron, TON and Sui. A check, not a guarantee. Free; no API key needed.

token.description: The token's contract address (the mint on Solana, the coin type on Sui)

chainId.description: The network the token is on, a chainId from get_networks

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: What the Soheil Router API is: version, router fee, the most an integrator may add, how keys are given, and where the docs and OpenAPI spec are. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The best price for a token swap on one network, or a transfer to another network (bridge), and what the sender signs to make it. Works on every network in get_networks. Returns toAmount, toAmountMin (the least the recipient gets), the fees, and one of: transactionRequest (EVM: approve approvalAddress for exactly fromAmount first unless fromToken is the coin), transaction (Solana), messages (TON), tron (Tron), cosmos (a Cosmos network) or deposit (an address to pay; nothing to sign). Call get_signing_guide with the quote's fromChainId for the exact steps. Works without an API key at a low shared rate; to earn your own fee without a key, give feeWallet and integratorBps (the sender sees the fee in fees). A free key gives your own limits.

fromChainId.description: Where the trade starts: a chainId from get_networks, e.g. 8453 for Base

toChainId.description: Where the recipient receives: fromChainId for a swap (the default), or another network from get_networks to bridge there

fromToken.description: Token sold, as that network writes it; on EVM networks the coin is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, elsewhere the network's nativeToken

toToken.description: Token bought, as the destination network writes it

fromAmount.description: Amount sold, an integer string in the token's smallest unit (or give toAmount)

toAmount.description: Instead of fromAmount, for a swap on one EVM network: an exact amount to receive. The quote's fromAmount is then what it takes to send, and toAmountMin is never below this amount

fromAddress.description: The wallet that pays and signs (or, for a deposit, the sender's own address there for refunds)

toAddress.description: Where the tokens go; defaults to fromAddress, required when the recipient is on another kind of network

slippageBps.description: Max price move in basis points, 1 to 5000 (default 50). A cross-chain route whose own swaps need more room may use up to 300; toAmountMin shows the least that arrives

integratorBps.description: Your own fee in basis points, added to the price the sender pays: up to your key's limit, or up to the most get_api_info names with feeWallet

feeWallet.description: Without a key: your EVM wallet (0x…) for your own fee (integratorBps). The fee is paid to it inside the trade, on-chain; get_earnings shows what it earned

tools.name: create_deposit_swap
tools.description: Opens a swap or a transfer to another network paid by deposit: you get a one-time address and the exact amount to send there from any wallet or exchange, and the tokens bought are paid to toAddress. Nothing to sign or approve and no wallet connection: for an agent that can send a transfer but not sign contract calls, or for a person paying from an exchange. refundAddress is required: a deposit that cannot be swapped goes back there. A token Soheil Guard marks RISKY is refused unless acceptRisk is true. The price includes the usual swap fee. Returns swapId (for get_deposit_status), sendTo (address, memo when needed, token, amount), receive (expected and minimum), deadline and steps. Send exactly sendTo.amount before deadline. Works on the networks get_networks lists with send: true and on the EVM networks. No API key needed; a few a caller per hour.

fromChainId.description: The network the deposit is sent on, a chainId from get_networks

fromToken.description: The token sent, by its address on that network (find_token gives it; the network's coin as get_networks names it)

fromAmount.description: How much is sent, a whole number in the token's smallest unit (1 USDC = 1000000)

toChainId.description: The network the tokens bought arrive on (fromChainId for a swap on one network)

toToken.description: The token bought, by its address on toChainId

toAddress.description: Where the tokens bought are paid, an address on toChainId

refundAddress.description: Your own address on fromChainId: a deposit that cannot be swapped is sent back there

acceptRisk.description: true to buy a token Soheil Guard marks RISKY anyway (default false)

tools.name: get_deposit_status
tools.description: Where a swap paid by deposit stands, by the swapId create_deposit_swap gave: PENDING_DEPOSIT, KNOWN_DEPOSIT_TX, PROCESSING, SUCCESS (payoutTxs paid toAddress), INCOMPLETE_DEPOSIT, REFUNDED or FAILED, with the transactions on both sides and what was paid out. final is true once nothing changes any more. Ask again every 30 seconds or so while it is not final. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: What trades paid a fee wallet as their integrator fee (the feeWallet of get_quote, or a key's fee address): trades, senders, volume and fees in USD for the last 30 days and all time, and per token sold (the fee in the token's smallest unit). Trades are counted once their transaction is final on an EVM network; fees on trades that start on Bitcoin, TON or Tron are paid separately and are not listed. No API key needed.

wallet.description: The fee wallet, an EVM address (0x…)

tools.name: get_signing_guide
tools.description: The exact steps to turn a quote into a sent trade on the network it starts on, and how to follow it afterwards: what to approve, what to sign, in which order, and which of txHash and id get_trade_status needs. Give the quote's fromChainId. No API key needed.

fromChainId.description: The network the trade starts on (the quote's fromChainId)

tools.name: get_trade_status
tools.description: Where a sent trade stands: PENDING, DONE (with what was paid and received; for a bridge, once paid on the destination; received gives the token and amount that arrived when known), REFUNDED (paid back on the source network; when refundBox is set, the refund waits in the user's own refund box: anyone may call its release(token) to send it to them), FAILED, NOT_FOUND or NOT_OURS. From an EVM network or Solana give txHash; from Bitcoin, TON, Sui (paid by deposit) and the deposit networks give id (the quote's id); from Tron, a Cosmos network and Sui (a transaction the wallet signed) give both. get_signing_guide says which. Works without an API key at a low shared rate.

txHash.description: The transaction's hash (0x + 64 hex on EVM; the signature on Solana; the digest on Sui; 64 hex on Tron and Cosmos)

id.description: The quote's id (0x + 64 hex), where the trade is followed by it

chainId.description: The network the trade was sent on (the quote's fromChainId)
